title: Finite correlated structure has a lossless one-endpoint J0 representation and role authority is semantic Aset membership
semanticClaim: Any finite ordered and multiplicity-preserving value sequence can be represented losslessly as one recursively structured Link endpoint.
Therefore finite arity, ordering and repeated values do not by themselves justify a true cross-current-member J1 join.
A physically materialized Link shaped like a role does not become an authorized role unless it is a semantic member of the selected role Aset.
explicitPremises: ExactSequence-style source values are represented recursively as Link topology with an explicit empty/root boundary.
Semantic role authority is defined by selected Aset membership.
exclusions: This does not prove J1 can never be useful for a future extension.
This does not yet close the empirical audit that every accepted v0.15 executable artifact avoids J1.
This does not create an ExactSequence ontology distinct from Links.
This does not infer semantic role membership from physical incidence/materialization.

architecturalConsequence.remainingJ1Gate: only an irreducible accepted artifact requiring simultaneous separate-current matching may justify J1
